title: The Vedic Age: Rig Vedic and Later Vedic Phases

faqs.q: The Aryans originally lived somewhere east of the Alps, in a region known as which area?
In which ancient text is the earliest specimen of the Indo-European language found?

Consider the following statements regarding the Rig Veda:
(I) It consists of ten mandalas.
(II) Books II to VII form its earliest portions.
(III) Books I and X seem to have been the latest additions.
Which of the above is/are correct?
The Rig Veda has many common features with which text, considered the oldest text in the Iranian language?
faqs.e: The two texts use the same names for several gods and even for social classes.

options.b: Socketed axes, bronze dirks and swords

faqs.a: Socketed axes, bronze dirks and swords
